pages.summary: La casa se queda en silencio. Con su pijama de reno, Robin se hace amigo de Crookshanks.

panels.scene: After-dinner warm wide living room. Pansy in evergreen sits near one end of the olive sofa while fire and Christmas lights glow. Crookshanks pads from the rug toward the tree. No baby yet.
panels.caption: Después de cenar, la casa se quedó en silencio.

panels.scene: Low angle on Robin crawling safely across the clear rug on four natural limbs in the soft reindeer pajamas, brown curls and open human green eyes visible. Pansy watches closely and leans forward.
panels.caption: Un pequeño reno apareció sobre la alfombra.

panels.scene: Pansy kneels near Robin and supports his balance with one hand. Robin gently touches the side of Crookshanks, who sits upright and accepts the touch. No grabbing or overlap of faces.
panels.caption: Crookshanks se olvidó de los adornos.

panels.scene: Close Pansy’s amused narrow green eyes and expressive black bob, one Robin's fabric antler in foreground, cat looking at Pansy from rug.
dialogue: Pansy: Traidor.

panels.scene: Hermione enters in loose gray pajamas with two steaming mugs held safely away from the rug, smiles at Pansy. Cat near chair, Robin still attended by Pansy.
dialogue: Hermione: Veo que se llevan mucho mejor.

panels.scene: The two adults set the mugs on the oak table above the rug level. Robin sits secure at Pansy's side on the sofa with one steady supporting arm. Crookshanks curls on a chair at a distance.
dialogue: Pansy: Crookshanks y yo no hemos hecho nada.

pages.summary: Con chocolate frente al árbol, Pansy y Hermione planean ver los escaparates navideños de Harrods.

panels.scene: Warm living room. Hermione in gray at left looks toward Pansy at right on olive sofa. Pansy holds one Robin in brown reindeer pajamas. Two mugs on oak table.
dialogue: Hermione: Mañana mis padres tienen cosas que hacer. Podemos salir un rato.

panels.scene: Close Pansy considers the warm tree lights, hand securely supporting Robin. Her face lights up as she names the place.
dialogue: Pansy: Quiero ver los escaparates navideños de Harrods.

panels.scene: Angle with Hermione first on left and Pansy on right. Hermione smiles knowingly, then Pansy replies. Both full faces, two distinct bubbles left and right high above.
dialogue: Hermione: Entre todos los lugares de Londres, escogiste el más exclusivo.
Pansy: Quiero ver si el lujo muggle está a mi altura.

panels.scene: Pansy smiles, Robin's tiny hands rest on her evergreen sleeve. Hermione answers while looking toward tree.
dialogue: Hermione: Harrods será, entonces.

panels.scene: Jane and Malcolm stand beside the oak archway and wave good night. Malcolm smiles toward baby, the green tree and fireplace separate behind sofa.
dialogue: Malcolm: Ese pequeño reno tiene energía para todos.

panels.scene: Quiet end. One Robin is drowsy in Pansy’s arms, his small nose and freckles visible, both teens fully dressed on sofa, mugs on table and sleepy orange cat on his chair.
panels.caption: Al fin, el pequeño reno empezó a quedarse dormido.

pages.summary: Hermione recuerda cómo Crookshanks recibió a Viktor. Pansy descubre que el gato también sabe calmar a Robin.

panels.scene: Quiet sofa conversation. Pansy at left holds one dozing Robin with soft antler hood, Hermione at right smiles. Crookshanks sits on the opposite chair.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Siempre ha sido tan territorial con tus visitas?

panels.scene: Hermione sets her mug on the table, amused. Pansy lifts an eyebrow and keeps one hand on Robin's back.
dialogue: Hermione: Con Ginny siempre fue cariñoso. Con Viktor fue otra historia.

panels.scene: Quick illustrated memory insert in the same sitting room some years earlier, one brass lamp tilted beside two fallen cushions and a vase in a few simple pieces. No people or action shown. Crookshanks on the chair in foreground with a satisfied expression.
panels.caption: Después de aquella visita, Viktor jamás volvió a quedarse a solas con él.

panels.scene: Return to sofa. Pansy laughs and glances over toward Crookshanks. Robin stirs slightly with a tiny sleepy frown, comfortably held.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Una estrella del quidditch derrotada por tu gato?

panels.scene: Pansy gently folds back Robin's soft antler hood, exposing his own human brown curls. Hermione looks down with a warm smile. The orange cat purrs nearby on a cushion, separated from baby.
dialogue: Pansy: Tranquilo, pequeño.

panels.scene: A quiet close of Robin dozing in Pansy’s arms, folds of brown fabric and one natural small hand. Crookshanks in the separate chair in middle ground.
dialogue: Pansy: Gracias, Crookshanks.

pages.summary: Hablan de Viktor y Draco. Pansy distingue el peso de las expectativas familiares de la posibilidad de elegir.

panels.scene: Pansy and Hermione on the olive sofa, slightly apart with Robin in Pansy’s supported arms. Pansy asks softly, looking toward tree.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Cómo era Viktor, en realidad?

panels.scene: Close Hermione turns her brown eyes toward Pansy. Chestnut curls, gray sleeves, arm resting normally near her own side.
dialogue: Hermione: Era amable conmigo. Su familia ya había hecho otros planes para él.

panels.scene: Pansy gazes at the old cloth owl low on the tree. Robin sleeps quietly, golden lights reflect softly on her green sweater.
dialogue: Pansy: Es el peso del apellido. Todos creen saber qué papel debes cumplir.

panels.scene: Hermione listens, one elbow relaxed on sofa arm, no mug in hand. The window is dark and reflected in warm brass.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿También fue así con Draco?

panels.scene: Pansy in thoughtful close view, baby still supported beneath shoulders and legs. She looks at Hermione rather than away.
dialogue: Pansy: Crecimos juntos. Nuestras familias daban por hecho que acabaríamos juntos.

panels.scene: Medium quiet two-shot, both look toward the tree. Pansy relaxes, Hermione listens and Crookshanks watches from the chair.
dialogue: Pansy: Al final entendimos que podíamos elegir.

panels.scene: Pansy sits beside Hermione again. Quiet close of two fully dressed friends talking, each face clearly separate. Crookshanks on chair.

panels.scene: Hermione smiles with visible relief, looking toward Robin’s pram while Crookshanks yawns on his own chair.

panels.scene: Quiet visual pause of their two mugs on the oak table, lights reflected in window. Outside first white snowflakes catch the street lamps.

pages.summary: Jane encuentra a Hermione en la habitación de invitados tras una noche de cuidar a Robin. Las llama a desayunar.

panels.scene: Morning establishing view of the guest room. Pansy looks up from sitting near edge of green bed. Hermione has dozed in the moss reading chair, gray pajamas and a closed book on lap. One Robin sleeps in his own bassinet on separate floor space.
panels.caption: La luz de la mañana entró por las cortinas.

panels.scene: Jane gently knocks on the partly open oak door, looks in with a kind amused smile. She sees her daughter in the reading chair and notices the quiet baby.
dialogue: Jane: ¿Hermione? El desayuno está casi listo.

panels.scene: Pansy stands quietly beside chair and answers Jane at doorway. Hermione begins to stir, both fully clothed and distinct. The dark green single bed in background.
dialogue: Pansy: Anoche lo ayudó a dormir y acabó quedándose en la butaca.

panels.scene: Jane steps away toward landing, one little smile. Pansy turns her eyes to Hermione. No other person or baby in hall.
dialogue: Jane: Pueden bajar cuando estén listas.

panels.scene: Hermione wakes in the chair and smiles sleepily up at Pansy. Pansy’s visible hand rests on chair arm, not touching the other person.
dialogue: Hermione: Cinco minutos.

panels.scene: Pansy gently lifts Robin with both hands from his own bassinet. He is now awake and looks up at her with a small yawn. Hermione stretches one arm normally in the background.
dialogue: Pansy: Tenemos que levantarnos, Granger.

dialogue: Jane: Buenos días, cielo.

panels.scene: Malcolm folds his newspaper with small unreadable ink marks. Hermione explains the day, and Pansy listens from across her cup.

panels.scene: Jane in sage cardigan looks from Hermione to Robin. One human baby touches the high-chair tray. Malcolm in background looks kindly on.
dialogue: Jane: Podemos llevar a Robin con nosotros. Conocerá a los cachorros.

pages.summary: Pansy abriga a Robin y Hermione prepara todo para el viaje con sus abuelos.

panels.scene: Robin in cream underlayer and trousers is supported sitting on the green duvet with Pansy in front of him. Pansy holds open the single navy sleeve for his hand.
dialogue: Pansy: Necesito tu mano, pequeño.

panels.scene: He offers the opposite hand with a bright grin. Pansy laughs quietly and puts the navy sweater on him gently with two human hands.
panels.caption: Robin ofreció la otra mano.

panels.scene: Hermione sorts two folded outfits, blue blanket and cloth book into one tan diaper bag on the side table. She has a concentrated practical expression. No quantities, formula instructions or medical equipment.
panels.caption: Hermione preparó la pañalera.

panels.scene: Pansy holds Robin fully dressed with his blue cap and tiny boots. She watches Hermione place another neatly folded shirt in bag.
dialogue: Pansy: Granger, irá a Derbyshire. No a Siberia.

panels.scene: The two come downstairs. Pansy supports Robin, Hermione has one diaper bag. Crookshanks watches the activity from the rug. Jane in camel coat approaches warmly.
dialogue: Jane: Pero qué guapo estás.

panels.scene: A quiet close of Hermione closing the bag zipper by the dark green door. Jane listens attentively and Malcolm steps out toward the driveway.
dialogue: Hermione: La manta azul es la que usa para dormir.
